title: Evaluation of a low degree binary polynomial
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers, let $c_S\in\mathbb F_2$ be a coefficient for each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$, and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The evaluation is $\sum_{|S|\leq\ell} c_S m_S(x)$, where $m_S(x)$ is the binary monomial associated with $S$.
hypotheses_covered: a coefficient in $\mathbb F_2$ is specified for each subset of size at most $\ell$
the input is an element of $\mathbb F_2^n$
